description: Use this when the user wants an attendance sheet or class roster template to print, with student or member names pre-filled from a pasted list, with one column per session date (from a list of dates, a start and end date with meeting days, a number of weeks, or a month) or blank date columns, plus a Total column. Long rosters continue on more pages and too many dates split into column sets, with headings repeated. Returns a PDF and a CSV template. Does not take attendance online, calculate grades or store records.

columns.description: Column headings to use instead of the defaults, as a list or comma separated text, e.g. ["Name", "Email", "Phone", "Signature"]. Any names work; widths follow the content (Email wide, Time In narrow, a "?" column is a tick box).

date.description: Date printed in the header, in any common form, e.g. "2026-11-14", "Nov 14 2026" or "11/14/2026" (read as US month/day). Leave out to print a blank Date line.

dates.description: Session dates for the column headings, e.g. ["2026-11-02", "2026-11-04"] or "Nov 2, Nov 4, Nov 6". Or use start_date with end_date, weeks, sessions or month.

days.description: Meeting days, e.g. "Mon, Wed, Fri", "MWF", "Tuesdays and Thursdays" or "weekdays" (default).

extra_columns.description: Columns to add to the defaults, e.g. "Dietary needs" or ["T-shirt size", "Initials"].

instructions.description: One line of instructions under the header, e.g. "Please print clearly". Each type has a default; "none" removes it.

location.description: Location printed in the header, e.g. "Room 204" or "Community Hall". Leave out for a blank line.

month.description: A whole month of meeting days, e.g. "November 2026".

names.description: Student or member names, pasted as one name per line, comma separated text or a list, e.g. "Ava Brown\nLiam Chen\nNoah Diaz" or ["Ava Brown", "Liam Chen"]. "Last, First" names stay whole when one per line. Leave out for blank name rows.

numbered.description: Print a # column with row numbers, e.g. true. Default true for sign-in, contact and attendance sheets.

org_name.description: Organization, school or business name printed above the title, e.g. "Maple Street PTA".

orientation.description: "portrait" or "landscape", e.g. "landscape". Default portrait (visitor logs and attendance sheets: landscape). Switches to landscape by itself when the columns do not fit.

page_size.description: Paper size: "Letter" (default, 8.5x11), "A4" or "Legal". "A4 landscape" also sets the orientation.

pages.description: Number of identical blank pages when no list is given, 1 to 50, e.g. 3. Default 1.

rows.description: Number of writing rows, e.g. 25 or "40 rows". Leave out to fill one page exactly. More rows than fit continue on more pages, each page full; "20 per page" sets rows per page.

sessions.description: Number of sessions (date columns), e.g. 10. Without dates the columns are left blank to write dates in.

sort.description: Sort the names: "last" (by last name), "first" (alphabetical) or leave out to keep the order given.

start_date.description: First class date, e.g. "2026-11-02". With end_date, weeks or sessions, dates are listed on the meeting days.

striping.description: Light gray shading on alternate rows (or alternate groups), e.g. false for plain rows. Default true.

subtitle.description: Optional second line under the title, e.g. "Quarterly review, 6 pm".

teacher.description: Teacher or instructor printed in the header, e.g. "Ms. Patel".

title.description: Class or group name printed as the heading, e.g. "Period 3 Biology". Default "Attendance Sheet".

total_column.description: Add a Total column at the end, e.g. false. Default true.

weeks.description: Number of weeks from start_date, e.g. 4.

name: generate_attendance_sheet
title: Generate attendance sheet
